text:
anand: ran a micro-sweep across us-west1 / europe-west1 / ap-southeast1 comparing L4, T4, A10G for embeddings + small-chat. attaching quick notes :mag:
kai: nice. quick headline?
maria: curious about p50/p95 and cost per request — especially for embeddings.
anand: headline: for embeddings L4 wins cost/throughput on batch workloads, A10G gives best single-request latency for chat, T4 is cheapest for tiny low-concurrency embeddings but loses on tail latency.
luca: can you paste the numbers? even roughs.
anand: sure, small table I pulled (p50 p95 / rps / $/1M tokens) — these are median of 3 runs, q4_0 where noted:

```
workload   gpu   p50(ms) p95(ms) rps   $/1M_tokens
embeds     L4    18      46      520  $4.2
embeds     T4    28      82      320  $3.1
embeds     A10G  22      60      480  $5.6
chat-mini  L4    34      120     90  $7.8
chat-mini  T4    55      210     45  $4.2
chat-mini  A10G  28      92     110  $9.3
```

anand: notes: embeddings used 128-dims batch size 64, small-chat = 512 tokens decode 128, sampling top-k. quant: L4/T4 were q4_0, A10G ran fp16 (we didn't have a validated q4 kernel on A10G for this model build).
kai: interesting that A10G still best p50 for chat even in fp16 — probably higher single-threaded freq + tensor cores.
maria: how about region differences? any EU/APAC anomalies?
anand: eu-west1 ~ +8-12% p50 vs us-west1 across GPUs (same image). ap-southeast1 slightly worse on throughput due to instance vCPU cap on our test fleet, p95s inflated by noisy neighbors on T4 spot instances.
luca: kernel choices?
anand: we used fused-attn for L4/T4 where supported, fallback to baseline attention for A10G fp16 run. fused-attn brought ~20% p50 improvement on chat for L4.
benchbot: automated plot uploaded -> https://infrabucket.s3/bench/1955554321/plots.png
maria: any quality regressions from q4_0 on small-chat?
anand: minimal on embeddings (cosine drop <0.003), small-chat shows a few hallucination cases when truncation + q4 combined; flagged one prompt set and opened eval run #19555.
kai: suggestion: run A10G q8 if kernel available, and try L4 fp16 in EU to compare parity.
anand: yep next steps: (1) add A10G q8 sweep (2) increase apac pool vCPUs to remove cap (3) inves tigate q4->hallucination prompt cluster and add eval asserts.
dev-rel-bot: note saved to /bench/notes/1955554321.txt :white_check_mark:
luca: thanks, neat. can you drop raw CSVs in the shared drive? i'll do capacity sizing baseline from these numbers.
anand: uploading CSVs now, ping when done. :thumbsup:
